title: Reduce GPU-heavy idle UI effects
goal: Improve perceived smoothness on the primary Agent and shared screen surfaces by removing continuously rendered blur effects and avoiding idle pulsing while respecting the user's Reduce Motion setting.
context: A focused UI-only stabilization task. It must not alter Agent execution, provider/runtime behavior, permissions, or data contracts.
forbidden_changes: Do not add Agent features or modify Agent Runtime, provider, workspace, or policy behavior.
Do not change conversation persistence or task execution semantics.
Do not claim zero jank or physical-device acceptance from source inspection or CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: The main Agent screen no longer relies on a large continuously blurred circle for its decorative background.
The Agent orb does not pulse continuously while idle.
Orb animation respects the system accessibility Reduce Motion setting and only pulses while active or thinking.
Shared screen background and panel styling avoid unnecessary large-radius blur/shadow effects.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Physical-device scrolling, idle, and streaming behavior is still checked before declaring the UI smooth.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the visual hierarchy regresses or any required check fails, revise or revert this small UI-only task; do not weaken the contract or claim device-level smoothness without testing.
